interpreted_request: 搜索支持 Java 的开源 LLM Agent 框架，重点调研 langchain4j/langchain4j，并给出依赖或源码依据。

criteria.name: 提供 LLM Agent 框架能力

candidates.summary: LangChain4j 是面向 JVM 的 Java LLM 应用库，提供统一 LLM/向量库 API、工具调用、Agent 与 RAG 能力，并含独立的 langchain4j-agentic 模块。

claims.text: README 自述为开源、惯用 Java 的 LLM 应用库，工具箱覆盖 prompt 模板、chat memory、function calling 到 Agents 与 RAG 等高层模式。
父 POM 声明 Apache-2.0 许可证，java.version=17 并作为 maven.compiler.release，说明构建目标为 Java 17。
langchain4j-agentic/pom.xml 定义 artifactId 为 langchain4j-agentic、name 为 Agentic Framework，依赖 dev.langchain4j:langchain4j。
仓库元数据：语言 Java，Apache-2.0，未归档，约 13.4k stars；最近提交 2026-11-12，最近发布 1.19.5（2026-11-02）。

assessments.reason: 父 POM 声明 Apache-2.0 许可证，元数据 license 为 Apache-2.0，仓库未归档。
元数据语言为 Java；父 POM 设置 java.version=17 与 maven.compiler.release，核心模块 langchain4j 为 Maven 构件。

assessments.criterion: 提供 LLM Agent 框架能力
assessments.reason: README 列出 Agents 高层模式；仓库含 langchain4j-agentic 模块（Agentic Framework），依赖核心 langchain4j。

candidates.decision_reason: 三项硬性条件均有依赖/源码或文档证据支持，且维护活跃（近期提交与发布均在 180 天窗口内）。
unknowns: 未运行目标代码，Agent 编排的实际性能与稳定性缺乏实测
langchain4j-agentic 模块的 API 细节未逐文件阅读

conclusion: langchain4j/langchain4j 满足开源、Java、LLM Agent 框架三项条件，可作为首选候选；其 Agent 能力由核心库 Agents 模式与 langchain4j-agentic 模块共同提供，构建基线为 Java 17。搜索到的其他候选未深入分析，不构成排除结论。
unknowns: 其他搜索结果候选未做证据级分析
未进行基准测试，性能与部署效果未确认

1: # LangChain4j: idiomatic, open-source Java library for building LLM-powered applications on the JVM
2: 
3: [![Build Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/langchain4j/langchain4j/main.yaml?branch=main&style=for-the-badge&label=CI%20BUILD&logo=github)](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/actions/workflows/main.yaml)
4: [![Nightly Build](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/langchain4j/langchain4j/nightly_jdk17.yaml?branch=main&style=for-the-badge&label=NIGHTLY%20BUILD&logo=github)](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/actions/workflows/nightly_jdk17.yaml)
5: [![CODACY](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codacy-Dashboard-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=codacy)](https://app.codacy.com/gh/langchain4j/langchain4j/dashboard)
6: 
7: [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1156626270772269217?logo=discord&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/JzTFvyjG6R)
8: [![BlueSky](https://img.shields.io/badge/@langchain4j-follow-blue?logo=bluesky&style=for-the-badge)](https://bsky.app/profile/langchain4j.dev)
9: [![X](https://img.shields.io/badge/@langchain4j-follow-blue?logo=x&style=for-the-badge)](https://x.com/langchain4j)
10: [![Maven Version](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/dev.langchain4j/langchain4j?logo=apachemaven&style=for-the-badge)](https://search.maven.org/#search|gav|1|g:"dev.langchain4j"%20AND%20a:"langchain4j")
11: 
12: 
13: ## Introduction
14: 
15: Welcome!
16: 
17: The goal of LangChain4j is to simplify integrating LLMs into Java applications.
18: 
19: Here's how:
20: 1. **Unified APIs:**
21:    LLM providers (like OpenAI or Google Vertex AI) and embedding (vector) stores (such as Pinecone or Milvus)
22:    use proprietary APIs. LangChain4j offers a unified API to avoid the need for learning and implementing specific APIs for each of them.
23:    To experiment with different LLMs or embedding stores, you can easily switch between them without the need to rewrite your code.
24:    LangChain4j currently supports [20+ popular LLM providers](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/integrations/language-models/)
25:    and [30+ embedding stores](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/integrations/embedding-stores/).
26: 2. **Comprehensive Toolbox:**
27:    Since early 2023, the community has been building numerous LLM-powered applications,
28:    identifying common abstractions, patterns, and techniques. LangChain4j has refined these into practical code.
29:    Our toolbox includes tools ranging from low-level prompt templating, chat memory management, and function calling
30:    to high-level patterns like Agents and RAG.
31:    For each abstraction, we provide an interface along with multiple ready-to-use implementations based on common techniques.
32:    Whether you're building a chatbot or developing a RAG with a complete pipeline from data ingestion to retrieval,
33:    LangChain4j offers a wide variety of options.
34: 3. **Numerous Examples:**
35:    These [examples](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples) showcase how to begin creating various LLM-powered applications,
36:    providing inspiration and enabling you to start building quickly.
37: 
38: LangChain4j began development in early 2023 amid the ChatGPT hype.
39: We noticed a lack of Java counterparts to the numerous Python and JavaScript LLM libraries and frameworks,
40: and we had to fix that!
41: 
42: **Despite the name, LangChain4j is not a Java port of LangChain (Python) — it is built for Java, not ported to it.**
43: It is an idiomatic Java library designed from the ground up around Java conventions:
44: type safety, POJOs, annotations, interfaces, dependency injection, fluent APIs, and first-class integrations with Quarkus, Spring Boot, Helidon, and Micronaut.
45: Its API, internals, and release cycle are independent of the Python LangChain project.
46: 
47: We actively monitor community developments, aiming to quickly incorporate new techniques and integrations,
48: ensuring you stay up-to-date.
49: The library is under active development. While some features are still being worked on,
50: the core functionality is in place, allowing you to start building LLM-powered apps now!
51: 
52: 
53: ## Documentation
54: Documentation can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev).
55: 
56: The documentation chatbot (experimental) can be found [here](https://chat.langchain4j.dev/).
57: 
58: 
59: ## Getting Started
60: Getting started guide can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/get-started).
61: 
62: 
63: ## Code Examples
64: Please see examples of how LangChain4j can be used in [langchain4j-examples](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples) repo:
65: - [Examples in plain Java](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples/tree/main/other-examples/src/main/java)
66: - [Examples with Quarkus](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-langchain4j/tree/main/samples) (uses [quarkus-langchain4j](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-langchain4j) dependency)
67: - [Example with Spring Boot](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples/tree/main/spring-boot-example/src/main/java/dev/langchain4j/example)
68: - [Examples with Helidon](https://github.com/helidon-io/helidon-examples/tree/helidon-4.x/examples/integrations/langchain4j) (uses [io.helidon.integrations.langchain4j](https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/io.helidon.integrations.langchain4j) dependency)
69: - [Examples with Micronaut](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-langchain4j/tree/0.3.x/doc-examples/example-openai-java) (uses [micronaut-langchain4j](https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-langchain4j/latest/guide/) dependency)
70: 
71: ## Useful Materials
72: Useful materials can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/useful-materials).
73: 
74: 
75: ## Get Help
76: Please use [Discord](https://discord.gg/JzTFvyjG6R) or [GitHub discussions](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/discussions)
77: to get help.
78: 
79: 
80: ## Request Features
81: Please let us know what features you need by [opening an issue](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/issues/new/choose).
82: 
83: 
84: ## Contribute
85: Contribution guidelines can be found [here](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
